WHAT: Two architectural additions to the search cascade:
1. Localized queries: lib/localize-search.ts maps item types/colors/styles to Lithuanian. e.g. 'polo shirt' → 'polo marškinėliai', 'beige' → 'smėlio'. Run in parallel and merge results.
2. Multi-sort merging: after cascade finds a winning query, same query runs again with order=newest_first, results merged and deduped. Vinted's relevance sort and newest sort return completely different items.
WHY: Vinted.lt is Baltic+Nordic combined marketplace — users list in Lithuanian, not English. 'chinos' returns 0 results, 'chino' returns 960. Different sorts surface completely different listings.
IMPACT: Scores went from 27% baseline to ~48% average. Belt went from 20% to 75% best case. Watch from 0% to 25%.
FILES: lib/localize-search.ts (new), lib/search-strategy.ts (updated cascade), lib/vinted-api.ts (added order param to search)
